# QuickMoments

> Live Breaking News, Market Intelligence & Financial Research Journal with Precision Mathematical Engines.

QuickMoments (https://www.quickmoment.fun) is an advanced digital news, market intelligence, and multi-mode computational platform. It unites three primary offerings:
1. **Live NewsRoom & Market Intelligence (Primary Focus)**: Real-time coverage across Technology & AI, Stock Markets (NIFTY 50, SENSEX, Wall Street), Economy & Macro Policy, Politics & Direct Tax Codes, and Global Geopolitics. Powered by live Economic Times RSS feeds and Yahoo Finance live market quotes.
2. **15+ Institutional-Grade Calculators**: Client-side, privacy-preserving computational engines for Loan EMI (with reducing-balance amortization), SIP Compounding, Income Tax FY 2025-26 (New vs Old regime comparison), CAGR, Retirement, Rent vs Buy, Health (Mifflin-St Jeor BMR & TDEE), and 100,000-trial Monte Carlo simulators.
3. **Peer-Reviewed Research Journal**: In-depth analytical whitepapers exploring frontloaded mortgage mechanics, tax inflection points, semiconductor GAA nanosheet physics, quantum Shor's algorithm, and BRICS dedollarization dynamics.

## Key Hubs & Navigation

- [Live NewsRoom & Homepage](https://www.quickmoment.fun/): Real-time newsroom feed and market updates across 5 divisions: Technology & AI, Stock Market & IPOs, Economy & Macro, Politics & Policy, and Global Geopolitics.
- [NewsRoom Dedicated Feed](https://www.quickmoment.fun/newsroom): Live feeds from The Economic Times & Yahoo Finance ticker.
- [Precision Calculators Hub](https://www.quickmoment.fun/calculators): EMI, SIP, Compound Interest, CAGR, Income Tax, Salary, Retirement, and GST calculators.
- [Research Blog & Whitepapers](https://www.quickmoment.fun/blog): 10 peer-reviewed guides covering finance, taxation, mathematics, and science.
- [Monte Carlo Simulation Lab](https://www.quickmoment.fun/simulations): Probabilistic simulation tools for investment outcome distributions and Monte Carlo Pi estimation.
- [CSV QuickStats Studio](https://www.quickmoment.fun/statistics): High-speed client-side statistical engine with descriptive metrics, linear regression, and distributions.
- [Unit & Developer Utilities](https://www.quickmoment.fun/converters): Universal measurement conversions and cryptographic/JSON developer tools.
